summary: Arrow Financial Corp filed an 8-K to report the completion of its acquisition of Adirondack Bancorp, Inc. on July 1, 2026. Each Adirondack share was converted into 1.8610 Arrow shares plus $18.72 cash, structured as a tax-free reorganization under IRC Section 368(a). The board appointed Adirondack's CEO Rocco Arcuri as director and regional president. No external advisors were named; bank system integration is expected later in 2026. The mix of stock and cash provides partial downside protection; watch for integration risk and stock price relative to the exchange ratio.
